facts.value: International students must obtain an F-1 or J-1 visa.
To obtain a visa, students must first receive a SEVIS number and I-20 document from ASU.
Students will receive their ASURITE User ID and activation instructions shortly after submitting their application.

Students log in to My ASU with their ASURITE User ID and password to view priority tasks, advisor contact information, financial aid and billing information, and connect to campus technology and services.
After enrolling in classes, students should visit asu.edu/emailsignup to activate their official @asu.edu email address.
Students can give their parents or guardians access to their academic records and the ability to pay tuition and bills through My ASU Parent Guest Access.
On-campus students must pay an enrollment deposit to confirm attendance.
All first-year students are required to take the math placement test at least seven calendar days before their Academic Orientation Session.
